policy: PyTorch/Inductor native operators; FlashAttention permitted, MiniWorld/CuEq computational kernels forbidden
limitations: CPU operator profiler includes compilation and eager/capture execution; event counts are not GPU kernel counts.
CUDA graph replay internals are not re-emitted as CPU operators; initial warmup/capture is included in the profiled forward.
AF3 uses original full benchmark sampling settings; other three models use shorter sampling and 3PTB.
Instrumentation changes execution overhead: recorded timings are not new speed measurements.
Protenix audit uses v1, not a new v2 qualification.

runs.scope: Full forward CPU operator profile including compile/capture; runtime timings are instrumented, not benchmark replacements

measurements_instrumented.benchmark_scope: model_forward; excludes input featurization and output decoding
